t: Add chain mode to work queue — implement item, closeout with track, auto-load next item without manual intervention
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai-ozi-work-queue-monitor.md — current dispatch logic. 2. Read templates/commands/wai-closeout.md — closeout steps that must run between items. 3. Read WAI-State.json _work_queue to understand item structure.
execute: 1. Add chain mode option to wai-ozi-work-queue-monitor.md: after completing an item, run a mini-closeout (lug reconciliation, state update, track finalize) then auto-load next ready item. 2. Chain mode requires explicit user approval: 'Chain mode: implement all ready items sequentially? [Y]es / [N]o'. 3. Between items: update _work_queue (remove completed, advance next), increment session_count, write track entry. 4. Stop conditions: queue empty, context >70%, any item fails verification. 5. Sync to all targets.
verify: 1. With 3 ready items and chain mode enabled: all 3 processed sequentially. 2. Context >70% between items: chain stops with warning. 3. Failed item: chain stops, item stays in queue with review_reason. 4. Each item gets its own track entries.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Chain mode for sequential work queue processing — mini-closeout between items, auto-advance
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not parallel execution — strictly sequential. Not bypassing closeout — each item gets proper state preservation.
